sections.text: Pressure tested deep set plug to 20/260bar for 5/10 minutes. Good test
Bled off pressure above deep set plug to close drain to 10bar. Performed inflow test of deep set plug. Good test
Bled down pressure from tubing. Closed HMV, confirmed SV and KWV closed l/d BHA
M/u shallow set plug BHA installed same into lubricator. Leak tested lubricator/qts to 20/345bar 5/10min. Opened HMV, SV
RIH shallow set plug to 256m
Correlated BHA across interval 200 300m Set plug with mid packer element at 249m. Tagged plug. POOH w/ setting tool to lubricator
Lined up cement pump and pressure tested shallow set plug to 20/230bar for 5/10min. Good test
Closed HMV,KWV and SV, verified no pressure in XT
Started r/d wireline equipment
Performed pre-job meeting w/ oncoming crew to r/d WL equipment
L/d plug setting tool
R/d lubricator, moved same from the rig floor
R/d upper wire line riser joint
Disconnected control lines and hoses to WL BOP and pulled same to rig floor meanwhile prepared to pull fox hole
R/d WL BOP and lower riser joint. Lifted BOP to pipe deck
Performed pre-job meeting for rearranging well hatches in moon pool
Removed hatches on f-12 and f-7 and beam between slots
Removed master bushing, installed chains to TDS and attached to XMT as per lifting plan, with double securing
Continued w/ attaching lifting arrangement to XMT meanwhile performed BOP test no. 2 pressure only) to 20bar
Performed high pressure test on BOP. Test no. 2 to 345bar
Continued to rig up to pull XMT. Took 1t tension with TDS and disconnected greyloc clamp below XMT meanwhile performed BOP test no 1 to 20/345bar for 5/10 min
Lifted XMT to moon pool and transported to skid according to lifting plan. Meanwhile lined up for BOP pressure test no. 3
Continued to move/handle XMT to moon pool hatch meanwhile performed BOP test no. 3 to 20/345bar 5/10 min, performed BOP test no. 4 to 20/345bar 5/10 min
Installed beam between slots and hatch on f-7 slot. Meanwhile lined up for BOP pressure test no. 5
Lifted spool spacer to the rig floor. Meanwhile performed BOP test no. 5, installed master bushing
Prepared wellhead to install HP riser. Meanwhile performed BOP test no. 6, removed lifting tool for foxhole
Cleared rig floor and HTS, meanwhile carried out TBT for testing BOP.
Continued working on wellhead. Measured RKB WH 19. 95m. Meanwhile continued pressure test on BOP. Prepared paperwork required for running HP riser and man riding on TDS

Installed communication collar. Meanwhile isolated TDS, hydraulic mech investigated sweating connection on link tilt cylinder. Finished pressure testing BOP and rigged down equipment used for pressure testing
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u high pressure riser meanwhile deisolated TDS, TBT
Connected all rigging equipment to TDS bails and picked up HP riser. Removed master bushing and half-moon hatches. P/u and RIH with HP riser, removed protector
Continued RIH w/ HP riser, cleaned and checked seal area and m/u nt2 connector
Performed pre-job meeting to skid BOP
